look: Prism Wisp, a F-rank GKOM variant from the Prism Wardens family: small floating mote of green light inside a faceted prism shell. Family anatomy: floating faceted light-spirits and prism sentinels built of rotating crystal plates. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: only a few small GKOM crystal growths (two or three finger-length points); most of its natural skin, hide or surface is exposed; the crystals are green-gold prism crystal. A marble-sized GKOM core orb, murky grey, dim faint pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Light: warm gold, white and soft rose accents, tiny subtle sun motes, feather-like light and halo rings
